author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'RCA: UMR-20260813-205208-feab killed' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  RCA_20260813_UMR-20260813-205208-feab.md | 106 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 106 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: This is a docs-only new-file diff (RCA markdown), tier1 by blast radius, but its central factual claim does not survive verification against the actual codebase: the 'Correction applied' section asserts a real database write via `superboss-register.py mark-umr-terminal --umr-id ... --status completed_unmerged ...` that was independently accepted by a 'structured-evidence gate'. Direct inspection of origin/master's scripts/superboss-register.py shows no `mark-umr-terminal` subcommand exists anywhere in the argparse subparser list, and `UMR_STATUSES` (the tuple backing the umr_tasks table's `CHECK(status IN (...))` constraint) is exactly `queued, dispatched, running, completed, failed, rejected_duplicate, sigterm_sent, killed` -- `completed_unmerged` is not a member, so a write with that status would raise a SQLite CHECK-constraint violation, not succeed silently as claimed. A repo-wide grep of every .py file for `mark-umr-terminal`, `mark_umr_terminal`, and `completed_unmerged` returns zero matches in real code -- the only places these strings exist are inside this same family of RCA markdown files, which cite each other as precedent in a self-reinforcing chain with no underlying implementation. The investigative/read-side claims (resource_governor.py --query-umr, gh api PR-comment checks, git cat-file/merge-base checks against the local veridian-scripts checkout) look individually plausible and consistent with real tooling, but the document's core corrective action -- the actual UMR status fix this RCA exists to perform -- is either fabricated or silently failed and misreported as accepted. Approving and merging this would certify a false record into the permanent audit trail and extend an already-merged chain of similarly unverifiable RCA docs. Issues found: Central claim unverifiable/false: `mark-umr-terminal` is not a real subcommand of scripts/superboss-register.py on origin/master (no matching add_parser call), so the cited invocation could not have executed as described.; `--status completed_unmerged` is not a valid UMR_STATUSES value in the umr_tasks schema's CHECK constraint (only queued/dispatched/running/completed/failed/rejected_duplicate/sigterm_sent/killed exist) -- the write this RCA claims succeeded would be rejected by SQLite itself if actually attempted.; The document also asserts a 'structured-evidence gate' independently verified the commit via git cat-file/merge-base before accepting the write; no such gate exists in the current update_umr_task()/mark-umr-terminal code path (which doesn't exist at all), so this description of the write mechanism is also unsupported by the actual code.; Systemic: this is not an isolated slip -- at least 8+ prior already-merged RCA_*.md files on master (e.g. UMR-20260813-104044-578b, -105702-b694, -105737-dfc4, -120128-4223, -141633-f0fc) reference this same nonexistent mark-umr-terminal/completed_unmerged mechanism as established, working precedent, forming a self-citing chain that was never checked against real code by whichever reviewer(s) approved those. This diff both relies on and extends that chain rather than catching it.; No .github/workflows/** changes in this diff -- the hard rule does not apply here.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
